Pliant Named as Supplier on UK Government's £13.2 Billion Payment Solutions 3 Framework
summary:
Pliant, a global fintech specialising in modular B2B payment solutions, today announced that it has been named as a supplier on Government Commercial Agency's (GCA) Payment Solutions 3 framework (RM6383). The appointment gives UK central government departments and wider public-sector organisations access to Pliant's commercial card and digital payment solutions through the government's procurement framework.
Pliant was named to Lot 1, Commercial Cards and Digital Payments, alongside Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds and NatWest. Pliant is the only fintech and non-bank among the five suppliers, providing public-sector buyers with an alternative to established banking providers. The four-year lot has a total indicative value of £13.2 billion, including VAT, representing potential spending across all suppliers rather than committed revenue.
The framework provides public-sector organisations with a streamlined procurement route to commercial card and digital payment services. Pliant's appointment follows a competitive procurement process and marks an important step in the company's expansion into the UK and the broader public sector. Through the framework, eligible organisations can access Pliant's commercial payment capabilities to support spending management, visibility and financial controls.
“Being named alongside four of the UK's largest banks is an important validation of what we've built and the role Pliant can play in modernising commercial payments,” said Malte Rau, CEO and co-founder of Pliant. “Public-sector organisations increasingly expect the same flexibility, control and digital capabilities from their payment infrastructure as businesses in the private sector. This framework gives them a new option and creates an exciting opportunity for Pliant to serve organisations across the UK.”
Payment Solutions 3 runs from October 2026 through September 2030 and succeeds the UK government's Payment Solutions 2 framework.
Government Commercial Agency (GCA) is the UK’s central commercial and procurement organisation, connecting public and private sectors to achieve the best outcomes for the UK and its citizens. GCA uses its commercial expertise to create a simpler procurement experience that redirects valuable resources into essential public services – creating value for the nation.

The four-year framework, running from 2026 to 2030 with an indicative value of £13.2 billion, provides public-sector organisations with streamlined access to digital payment and commercial card solutions.

TBC Uzbekistan Launches Business and Corporate Cards, Expands Offering for SMEs
summary:
TBC Uzbekistan, Central Asia’s leading digital financial ecosystem and part of London-listed TBC Bank Group, today announces the launch of business and corporate debit cards, further strengthening its offering for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Central Asia’s most populous nation.
The new card products are part of TBC Business, Uzbekistan’s first fully digital banking solution for businesses. Since its launch in December 2024, TBC Business has seen growing demand, with more than 45,000 businesses now registered with the platform.
Business debit cards are aimed at individual entrepreneurs, enabling them to withdraw cash directly from their business account, manage all business-related expenses and create clearer separation between their personal and business finances. The card is part of TBC Uzbekistan’s wider offering for small businesses, through which they can accept customer payments, pay suppliers and make key business purchases, all online and without ever having to visit a branch.
Corporate cards are designed for legal entities to issue to their employees, providing a seamless, cashless way for employees to handle day-to-day business expenditures such as travel, business meetings and hospitality. Companies can set individual spending limits per employee and per transaction type, allowing them to maintain close oversight of employee spending.
Nika Kurdiani, CEO of TBC Uzbekistan, commented: “TBC Business is designed to help Uzbekistan’s growing pool of SMEs seamlessly handle their daily financial needs, from banking and payments to accessing the capital they need to grow. With the launch of corporate and business cards, we’re continuing to add new capabilities, taking the hassle out of business banking while giving entrepreneurs and businesses more control and oversight over day-to-day company expenditure. SMEs continue to be a key engine of national economic growth, and we’re proud to be playing an important role in helping them reach their full potential”.
Both cards are issued as Visa Business Platinum cards. Cardholders can access airport business (CIP) lounges and take advantage of special offers provided through the Visa Business Platinum programme, subject to the applicable terms and conditions.
The launch comes as TBC Uzbekistan continues to build the region’s leading two-sided ecosystem for businesses and consumers. It represents the latest addition to TBC Business, following the introduction of a dedicated mobile app, unsecured and secured SME loans, a fully digital payroll product and QR-code payment functionality.
In addition to rolling out new features, TBC Uzbekistan further strengthened its business offering via the acquisition of a majority stake in BILLZ in June 2025. BILLZ, Uzbekistan’s leading retail management SaaS platform, has added new capabilities to TBC Business, positioning it as a leading one-stop shop for businesses to handle all their financial and operational needs.

Newland Payment Technology Reaches 15 Million Terminal Deployments in Brazil as Focus Shifts to Android
summary:
Newland Payment Technology (NPT), a global provider of payment terminals and technology solutions, has reached more than 15 million payment terminal deployments in Brazil since entering the market in 2018. The company is now building on its success in Brazil to deepen acquirer partnerships across Latin America and develop new services as customers upgrade to Android terminals. 
Brazil is one of Newland NPT’s key markets globally, with terminals manufactured locally through partner facilities in Amazonas and São Paulo. The two locations provide production flexibility and help maintain supply if operations at either site are disrupted. Local teams manage component supply and customer orders, while a dedicated repair and after-sales operation provides technical expertise, spare parts and capacity to support large terminal estates.  
These capabilities allow Newland NPT to support acquirers from initial deployment through the working life of their devices. Alongside this operational support, the company makes R&D resources available to customers to adapt products to local requirements and develop new solutions together. 
In Brazil, that adaptation includes supporting card payments alongside Pix, the country’s instant payment system, so merchants can accept both through a single device. 
A growing focus is the transition from conventional terminals to Android devices, which give acquirers more flexibility to offer business applications alongside payments. With suitable software, merchants can issue tax receipts, manage inventory and take payments on the shop floor. This allows acquirers to build services around the needs of different merchants and play a greater role in their daily operations. 

Gilson Carvalho, General Manager for Latin America at Newland Payment Technology, said: “Reaching 15 million deployments reflects the depth of our relationships with Brazilian acquirers. What I’m most proud of is that customers come back to us and involve us in their plans. They know we can deliver the volumes they need, but they also want our help with what comes next. Our R&D teams work with them to understand what would make their services more useful to merchants and how we can bring those ideas to market. 
“Android gives us more scope to do that. Acquirers can build their own services around the device, and we can work with them to develop new uses for it. That’s an exciting part of our growth across Latin America: helping customers do more with the technology, backed by the production and support to deliver it.” 
The Brazil milestone provides a foundation for Newland NPT’s next stage of growth across Latin America. The company is focused on deepening acquirer partnerships across the region and building on its combination of reliable technology, global capabilities and local delivery.

The company is now focusing on expanding its presence across Latin America and shifting toward Android-based terminals. title: Paysafe Launches the PaysafeGo Solution, Helping Businesses Offer Their Own Digital Wallet
summary:
Paysafe, a global payments platform built for the experience economy, today announced the launch of the PaysafeGo wallet solution, a new merchant wallet offering that enables businesses to deliver their own branded digital wallet experience while leveraging Paysafe's regulated infrastructure, operational expertise and decades of digital wallet experience.
Built on the expertise gained from operating global digital wallet brands for decades, the PaysafeGo solution provides enterprises with a simple and compliant way to launch a branded wallet experience, helping them own the customer relationship while avoiding the operational and regulatory complexity typically associated with becoming a wallet operator.
The PaysafeGo solution is designed for businesses across industries including travel, retail, gaming, marketplaces, gig economy and creator platforms that are increasingly looking beyond payments acceptance to create deeper, ongoing relationships with their customers. By enabling users to receive, hold, transfer and spend funds within a branded wallet environment, businesses can transform payments from a transactional touchpoint into an engagement and loyalty driver.
"Consumers increasingly expect seamless experiences wherever they engage with brands, and payments are a critical part of that journey," said Bob Legters, Chief Product Officer at Paysafe. "The PaysafeGo wallet solution enables businesses to launch their own branded wallet experience without taking on the burden of licensing, compliance, fraud management, issuing and operational support. By combining the flexibility merchants need with the regulated infrastructure and expertise Paysafe provides, we're helping our partners create stronger customer connections, simplify money movement and unlock new opportunities for growth, so they can spend less time managing payments complexity and more time serving their customers."
The PaysafeGo wallet solution is available through two deployment models designed to accommodate different business requirements.
The Embedded Wallet model enables businesses to integrate a fully branded wallet experience directly into their existing applications and platforms through Paysafe APIs and SDKs. Businesses maintain control over the customer experience and user interface, while Paysafe manages complex backend services including KYC, AML, issuing, settlement, reconciliation, fraud management, compliance, and cross-border payouts.
The Turnkey Wallet model offers a faster path to market through a co-branded wallet experience hosted and managed by Paysafe. In this model, Paysafe manages infrastructure, security, compliance and virtual card issuing, while enabling businesses to maintain a strong branded presence and customer relationship.
Key capabilities of the PaysafeGo wallet solution include real-time payouts, seamless bank and peer-to-peer transfers, branded prepaid cards, customer loyalty and rewards experiences, integrated security and compliance controls, and end-to-end operational support. The solution is designed to help businesses reduce payment and payout costs, eliminate manual operational workflows, increase platform engagement and create new recurring revenue opportunities.
The PaysafeGo solution is built on Paysafe's licensed and regulated infrastructure, with embedded KYC, AML, fraud controls and compliance capabilities designed to help businesses meet regulatory requirements while delivering secure and convenient experiences for their customers.

content: Global payments platform Paysafe has launched PaysafeGo, a new wallet solution allowing businesses to offer their own branded digital wallets. The service is available in embedded and turnkey models, helping companies across travel, retail, and gaming enhance customer engagement while Paysafe handles regulatory compliance, fraud management, and backend operations.

Charity Bank Selects Temenos SaaS for Core Banking and Payments
summary:
Temenos, a global leader in banking technology, today announced that Charity Bank, a UK social purpose bank that uses savers’ deposits to provide loans to charities, social enterprises and other organizations creating positive social and environmental impact, has selected Temenos to modernize its core banking and payments platform.
Charity Bank will adopt Temenos Core and Payments delivered as SaaS and hosted on Microsoft Azure. The bank selected Temenos for the breadth of its core banking and payments functionality, its UK banking capabilities and its experience serving specialist banks.
The move to Temenos SaaS will give Charity Bank a simpler, scalable technology foundation to support its growth, with Temenos managing platform operations, maintenance and upgrades. This will help the bank adapt as its needs evolve while freeing resources to focus on serving the financial needs of charities and social purpose organizations.
Ed Siegel, Chief Executive, Charity Bank, commented: “Charity Bank exists to use money for good. We use our savers’ deposits to provide loans to charities, social enterprises and other organizations creating positive social and environmental impact across the UK. Selecting Temenos is an important step in modernizing our technology and strengthening the platform that supports our customers. We believe its banking capabilities and experience will help us build a more resilient and scalable service as Charity Bank develops.”
Mark Yamin-Ali, Managing Director, Europe, Temenos, said: “Supporting Charity Bank’s growth reflects our commitment to helping banks create opportunities for their customers while making a positive contribution to society. Specialist banks such as Charity Bank stand out through their understanding of the customers and communities they serve, and the Temenos SaaS offering helps them operate more efficiently while focusing on those relationships.”
This latest announcement adds to Temenos’ track record in the UK specialist banking market, following Reliance Bank’s selection of Temenos SaaS for core banking, digital and payments, and Kingdom Bank’s go-live with Temenos Core, Payments and Financial Crime Mitigation on Temenos SaaS.

content: Charity Bank has selected Temenos SaaS for its core banking and payments platform modernization. Hosted on Microsoft Azure, the new technology foundation will help the UK social purpose bank scale its operations, improve efficiency, and support growth. This partnership strengthens Temenos' presence in the UK specialist banking market, following similar agreements with other regional financial institutions.
